title: Waiver With a Deadline
after: after Lab 8 (exemptions); one resource group, no container group
space: the student's own Dojo Cloud subscription (`{user}`), its resource group `rg-{user}-c2` (the only assignment and exemption scope), and their own repo `{user}/challenge-c2` (cloned to `~/lab/challenge-c2`, local state)
goal: Assign the seeded `deny` rule (every resource group needs a `reviewedBy` tag) at the scope of `rg-{user}-c2` only, then waive the existing group with a `Waiver` exemption that expires within 14 days, all as code. Then destroy it and leave nothing assigned there.
constraints: Resource-group scope only; the exemption must carry an expiry date (a waiver without a deadline is a permanent hole).
verify_text: Two steps. Step 1 (`dojo-check c2` while it is applied): Dojo Cloud Policy (own subscription, read-only) has an assignment at the scope of `rg-{user}-c2` whose definition has the literal effect `deny` and mentions `reviewedBy`, with at least one exempt resource, no non-compliant one, and an unexpired `Waiver` exemption on it that expires within 14 days; and `main.tf` on `main` of `{user}/challenge-c2` declares an `azurerm_resource_group_policy_exemption`. Step 2 (after `tofu destroy`, `dojo-check c2` again): no assignment is left at the scope of `rg-{user}-c2`. The description text is not checked.
isolation: the assignment and the exemption are scoped to the student's own resource group `rg-{user}-c2` in their private subscription; the cloud check reads only the checking student's own Policy blade and the repo is their own.
hints: Lab 8's exemption is the shape; only the scope and the assignment differ.
Apply the starter first so the group exists before the deny does; `expires_on` wants an RFC 3339 time such as 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z.
seed: `dojo-challenge start c2` creates `{user}/challenge-c2` (cloned to `~/lab/challenge-c2`): a `main.tf` with the resource group `rg-{user}-c2` (no `reviewedBy` tag) and the `deny` definition `require-reviewedby-c2`, two TODOs, the rule in `rules/require-reviewedby.json`, provider files with local state, and a README with the brief.

then.text: run `tofu destroy` in ~/lab/challenge-c2 so nothing of the challenge is left assigned at rg-{user}-c2, then `dojo-check c2` again.

answer: `dojo-challenge start c2`, `cd ~/lab/challenge-c2`, `tofu init && tofu apply` (the starter). Then add `resource "azurerm_resource_group_policy_assignment" "reviewedby" { name = "require-reviewedby-c2", resource_group_id = azurerm_resource_group.c2.id, policy_definition_id = azurerm_policy_definition.require_reviewedby.id }` and `resource "azurerm_resource_group_policy_exemption" "waiver" { name = "c2-waiver", resource_group_id = azurerm_resource_group.c2.id, policy_assignment_id = azurerm_resource_group_policy_assignment.reviewedby.id, exemption_category = "Waiver", description = "Owner adds reviewedBy within two weeks (ticket OPS-123)", expires_on = "<today + 7 days>T00:00:00Z" }`. `tofu apply`, push `main.tf`, `dojo-check c2`; then `tofu destroy` and `dojo-check c2` again.
